## Context

The project has audience guidance distributed across AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/README.md, and individual documents. It lacks one current-state policy that distinguishes durable records, maintained documentation, shipped help, comments, generated artifacts, and protected evidence. The audit ticket minimum-rainy-fawn approved F01 and rejected broad prose cleanup and general prose validation. The parent epic washedup-cattish-mealworm assigns the lossless catalog relocation to F01 so F06 can remain a one-file navigation rewrite.

## Current enforcement and history

Ticket forworn-zanyish-narwhale added generated markers, two contributor tables in docs/README.md, and tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py after repeated changes edited derived outputs instead of their sources. The test owns the GENERATED and GATED_HAND_AUTHORED collections. It has three table consumers. _readme_rows supports test_readme_table_matches_registry and test_readme_lists_the_hand_authored_gated_surfaces. test_readme_rows_name_the_regenerate_command reads docs/README.md directly. test_contributing_points_at_the_generated_artifacts_table asserts the old docs/README.md anchor. The module text and section comments also name docs/README.md as the inventory. This change preserves both collections, every catalog row, and all marker checks.

## Plan

Add docs/documentation-policy.md as the current policy for tickets, ADRs, internal documentation, external documentation, shipped help, comments, generated artifacts, and protected evidence. Define the audience, purpose, lifecycle, canonical source, use of citations, correction method, exclusions, and examples for each category. Remove the merged Writing rules section from docs/documentation-policy.md. Retain only the approved ownership, lifecycle, canonical source, citation, correction, generated artifact, historical record, exclusion, and example content. Remove writing-rule claims from AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/README.md. Do not add character, diction, formal voice, paragraph shape, or other general writing restrictions. Those items belonged to rejected F02. Restore the four generated-artifact catalog row descriptions that F01 rewrote despite its lossless-relocation requirement. State that ticket events remain append-only. State that ADR decision substance is preserved through annotations, errata, supersession, or replacement ADRs.

Add docs/generated-artifacts.md as the contributor inventory. Move the existing generated and parity-gated tables from docs/README.md without changing their rows. Rename _readme_rows to _catalog_rows. Repoint test_readme_table_matches_registry, test_readme_lists_the_hand_authored_gated_surfaces, and test_readme_rows_name_the_regenerate_command to docs/generated-artifacts.md. Rename those tests so their names describe the catalog. Update the module text and section comments so they name docs/generated-artifacts.md. Update test_contributing_points_at_the_generated_artifacts_table so it requires the docs/generated-artifacts.md pointer instead of docs/README.md#generated-artifacts. Rename that test to describe the catalog pointer. Preserve the GENERATED and GATED_HAND_AUTHORED values. Replace the old CONTRIBUTING.md anchor. Add concise policy pointers in AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/README.md.

## Exclusions

- No edits to generated outputs, ADR decision substance, ticket events, historical evidence, protected evidence, or commit history.
- No repository-wide prose rewrite.
- No prose or comment validator.
- No character, diction, formal voice, paragraph shape, or other general writing restrictions.
- No F05 ownership descriptor, generated catalog generator, or new ADR.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The policy role table covers exactly eight roles listed in the Plan.
- [x] Every policy role entry provides all fields listed in the Plan.
- [ ] docs/documentation-policy.md contains no character restrictions.
- [ ] docs/documentation-policy.md contains no diction, formal voice, paragraph shape, or other general writing restrictions from rejected F02.
- [ ] AGENTS.md describes docs/documentation-policy.md as an ownership and correction policy.
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING.md limits the policy pointer to ownership, canonical source selection, and correction paths.
- [ ] docs/README.md does not claim that the policy defines writing requirements.
- [ ] The docs/cli-reference.md, server.json, criteria_routing.json, and reviewer prompt catalog row descriptions match their pre-F01 text.
- [x] The policy states every approved punctuation rule from minimum-rainy-fawn.
- [x] The policy states the approved paragraph-shape rule from minimum-rainy-fawn.
- [x] The policy states every approved diction rule from minimum-rainy-fawn.
- [x] The policy requires a formal voice for new or edited maintained text.
- [x] The policy requires ticket corrections through new append-only events.
- [x] The policy requires ADR corrections through annotations, errata, supersession, or replacement ADRs without erasing decision substance.
- [ ] docs/generated-artifacts.md contains the same generated table rows that docs/README.md contained before this change.
- [ ] docs/generated-artifacts.md contains the same parity-gated table rows that docs/README.md contained before this change.
- [x] The GENERATED value in tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py is unchanged.
- [x] The GATED_HAND_AUTHORED value in tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py is unchanged.
- [x] Every inventory consumer in tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py reads docs/generated-artifacts.md.
- [x] No inventory documentation in tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py identifies docs/README.md as the catalog.
- [x] The CONTRIBUTING pointer test requires docs/generated-artifacts.md.
- [x] AGENTS.md links to docs/documentation-policy.md.
- [x] CONTRIBUTING.md links to docs/documentation-policy.md.
- [x] docs/README.md links to documentation-policy.md.
- [x] CONTRIBUTING.md links to docs/generated-artifacts.md.
- [x] No maintained file references docs/README.md#generated-artifacts after the move.
- [ ] The targeted marker test passes.
- [x] [non-codebase] make lint passes.
